international.title: GTA 6 bedazzles gamers in Australia with ‘fully lived in, breathable world’
international.summary: Players can renovate houses, fix cars, lift weights and follow the story in Grand Theft Auto VI’s Miami-inspired Vice City Gamers across Australia woke up Thursday morning feeling like Christmas came early, some bleary-eyed from late night sessions on the Playstation, others with grand plans for a weekend foray in Vice City when their day jobs let them loose. Grand Theft Auto VI, more than a decade in the making, is here. And the reviews, mere hours into release, reflect universal acclaim. The game has already vaulted to the top spot on Metacritic’s list of the best games of all time, sitting above 1998’s The Legend of Zelda, Ocarina of Time with an unprecedented 99/100 score.
